items.Sentence: For Septic Systems, the Following Additional requirements Apply: a. Septic tank cleanings shall be performed only by a duly authorized service.
For Activated Sludge and Aerated Pond Systems, the Following Additional Provisions Apply:

For Aerated Pond Systems, the Following Additional Requirements Apply: Basins or ponds shall have sufficient capacity to accommodate allowable wastewater flow and design seasonal precipitation and ancillary inflow and infiltration during the winter season.
If sewage sludge is land applied, disposed of at a monofill, or incinerated, this activity shall comply with existing Federal, State, and local laws and regulations...
If collected screenings, sludges, and other solids removed from liquid wastes are disposed of at a landfill, such disposal shall comply with CCR, Title 23, Section 2510, et seq. (Chapter 15).
